why each dependency.qrcode-generator: the eSIM activation code as a QR (dependency-free, runs in the browser)
why each dependency.@fontsource/newsreader, @fontsource/schi: Tidewell's self-hosted fonts (no Google Fonts at runtime)
why each dependency.lucide-react: Tidewell's icon set, bundled behind the Icon primitive (no CDN at runtime); 0.460.0 is the version the handoff names
why each dependency.vite, @vitejs/plugin-react: dev server with the /tmf-api and /internal proxy, production build
why each dependency.typescript, @types/react, @types/react-d: type checking (5.x: openapi-typescript and typescript-eslint require it; @types/node for vite.config.ts)
why each dependency.openapi-typescript: types generated from spec/*.yaml, never from /openapi.json
why each dependency.eslint, @eslint/js, typescript-eslint, e: lint; react-hooks catches real bugs (missing dependencies, conditional hooks)
why each dependency.prettier: formatting, the ruff format of this directory
why each dependency.@playwright/test: the e2e smoke (make web-e2e), run in the official Playwright image of the same version

scripts.build: npm run types && tsc --noEmit && vite build
scripts.lint: npm run types && tsc --noEmit && eslint . --max-warnings 0 && prettier --check .
scripts.test: npm run test:local && npm run test:timezone
